user.title: Connect to a Yamaha MTX
user.description: Supported: MTX3 and MTX5-D. The MTX accepts up to 8 remote control connections at the same time.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the MTX. Enter `simulator` (MTX3) or `simulator-mtx5d` (MTX5-D) to try the integration without hardware.
data_description.port: Yamaha remote control port, 49280 by default.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of this MTX.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the MTX. Enter `simulator` (MTX3) or `simulator-mtx5d` (MTX5-D) to try the integration without hardware.
data_description.port: Yamaha remote control port, 49280 by default.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address, the network and that the MTX is powered on.
error.unsupported_model: This device reports itself as {model}. Only MTX3 and MTX5-D are supported.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.wrong_device: Another device answers at this address. Enter the address of the MTX that belongs to this entry.

init.title: Entities
init.description: Choose which groups of controls become entities. Matrix crosspoints create many entities (MTX3: 416, MTX5-D: 1088); the `set_crosspoint` action works without them.

data_description.inputs: Level and on/off of every input channel.
data_description.zones: Master level and on/off of every zone.
data_description.outputs: Level and on/off of every output channel.
data_description.router: Source selection (zone or YDIF input) of every output channel.
data_description.dca: Level and mute of the input and zone DCA groups A-H.
data_description.matrix: Level and on/off of every input-to-zone crosspoint.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the MTX at {host}: {error}

unsupported_model.message: The device at {host} is a {model}. Only MTX3 and MTX5-D are supported.

wrong_device.message: Another device answers at {host} (serial {serial}). Reconfigure this entry if the MTX has a new address.

entry_not_found.message: No Yamaha MTX entry found with id {entry_id}.

invalid_crosspoint.message: {device} has no crosspoint from {source} to zone {zone}.

invalid_command.message: The command must be a single line of text.

set_crosspoint.name: Set crosspoint
set_crosspoint.description: Sets the level and/or on state of one matrix crosspoint (input to zone). Works without the crosspoint entities.

source.name: Source
source.description: Matrix input: CH, ST IN or FX RTN.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the crosspoint on or off.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends one raw Yamaha remote control (RCP) command and returns the reply line, including ERROR replies. For advanced use.

config_entry_id.name: MTX
config_entry_id.description: The MTX to send the command to.

command.name: Command
command.description: One RCP command line, for example a get or set.
